mentions.name: Vocabuo
mentions.description: A language learning app that combines spaced-repetition vocabulary flashcards with a browser, ebook reader, and YouTube viewer. Focused on vocabulary only, it supports language-specific features such as showing each word with a different sentence and image on every review.
mentions.problem: Generic flashcard apps like Anki are not tailored specifically to vocabulary and language learning.

mentions.description: A vocabulary-focused language learning app. Words to learn come from YouTube videos, websites, and ebooks the user imports into the app, and flashcards are optimized specifically for vocabulary: cards automatically get audio, images, multiple sentence examples, and word definitions, and can be created fully monolingual with just definitions or words in dialogs.
